ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Birth and death are the great matter; impermanence is swift is an urgency formula. In its two exact corpus deployments it interrupts postponement: Jinian Jingxian uses it to praise refusing tomorrow’s feast, while Gaofeng Qiaosong Yi recalls it when abandoning ordinary study over whether reading could escape birth and death.
EvidenceBody: Jinian Jingxian asks whether the Wayfarer of Jingshan refused the next day’s feast precisely because he painfully kept the formula in mind, contrasting that refusal with accumulation and delay. Gaofeng Qiaosong Yi’s record places the formula in his own youthful question after seeing chrysanthemums wither and return: can reading avoid birth and death? The next sentence says he stopped his studies.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: A general mortality warning is deployed as the explicit pressure behind two concrete refusals to postpone or substitute another activity.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: Only two exact independent works are available, so the entry remains provisional and does not claim that every exhortation about urgency belongs to this fixed couplet.
